Auth.//: Public self-registration is closed by default until there is a privacy policy / GDPR story (iteration 4.11). Login and the demo account stay open. Flip to true (or override per-environment) to reopen.

DataProtection.//: The key ring that encrypts users' AI keys is stored in the database and must be encrypted with a certificate outside Development (ADR-028). Set DataProtection__CertificateBase64 and DataProtection__CertificatePassword as secrets; never commit them.
